home.subtitle: Visual Designer / Motion Designer
home.name: Hi, I'm Homer Shie
home.bio: I'm Homer, a visual designer with 9 years of experience, now focused on Vue / React frontend development. I transform complex logic into intuitive visual language, capable of defining a product's visual depth and independently delivering the full loop from UI/UX to frontend implementation. I've collaborated long-term with Garmin and received recognition from a Pixar animator during college. I believe AI tools streamline workflows, but great products need more than stable code — they need a visual soul that resonates with users.

about.subtitle:
9 years of visual experience, bringing design concepts to life through code.
I focus on transforming complex logic into intuitive, dynamic digital experiences.
about.bio_p1: Over the past 9 years of visual design, I've deeply participated in diverse commercial projects on a freelance basis. I worked long-term with Garmin, transforming complex wearable device interfaces into compelling visual experiences — the "Muse of Thursday" collaboration honed my precision in motion timing. Years of collaboration across industries gave me deep insight into cross-disciplinary communication.
about.bio_p2: To bridge the gap between design and engineering, I dove into full-stack development, culminating in the MemeDam project. More than a technical exercise, it was a complete product architecture practice — from database ERD design and Redis cache optimization to frontend interactive animations. I love turning static designs into "working logic" through code.
about.bio_p3: As an INTJ, I naturally seek rational, systematic paths within sensory creative work. Whether it's body composition management, playing rock guitar, or immersing in ACG culture — these interests ultimately feed back into my design. I'm not just a visual builder; I'm a logic weaver, committed to making aesthetics more than surface-level, backed by technical depth.

experiences.title: Frontend Engineering & Product Development

79.description: WatchiBeastie combines the classic virtual pet raising game with health habit goals, motivating you to exercise more, eat well, and sleep tight with your Garmin watch to evolve your beastie!

80.title: Virtual Mountain
80.description: The virtual scenery of mountains formed by blurry lines and dots sets the background for metallic numbers up front to create a sci-fi feeling. Pick your favorite background color from the three options available.

81.title: Would You Like to Build a Snowman?
81.description: Would you like to build a snowman? Now you can! Without getting cold and wet in a snowfield too! Reach your daily goals, and the snowman will be built and dressed for you.

82.title: Golf in the Snow
82.description: Winter is coming! And looks like Santa is warming up for his trip around the globe!

83.title: 2024 Garmin Run Asia Series
83.description: GARMIN RUN ASIA SERIES is back, and this year the event has expanded to nine cities across Asia. Count down to the next stage or display your selected city with a matching stylized cityscape in the background.

84.title: Christmas Wreath
84.description: Start decorating this Christmas with a wreath on your wrist! The wreath comes with vintage gold fonts that evoke the joy of Christmas. Switch between 4 options: pinecones, gingerbread men, candy canes, and baubles.

85.title: Trail Runner
85.description: This woodblock-print styled watch face depicts a runner heading toward the horizon across different landscapes. The landscape changes as you reach different altitudes.

86.title: Live Healthy and Be STRONG!
86.description: Embrace a healthier lifestyle with Strong—Mascot of the World Masters Games 2025! Strong leads with a morning run to kick off the day, followed by 10 animated sports in the afternoon, and restful sleep at night. All while counting down to the WMG opening day!

87.title: Flowing Clock
87.description:
Time in Motion: A Visual Meditation with Canvas
More than just a clock, this is a visual experiment in the fluidity of time. Using JavaScript and Canvas, abstract curves flow and morph with every passing second. A fusion of logic and aesthetics—a poetic visualization of time you can watch unfold.

88.title: Weight of Wealth
88.description:
A Clicker Game of Calories, Cravings & Capitalism.
In this meme-style incremental game, you don’t earn gold—you hoard calories. Click falling fries, unlock nuggets and burgers, and hire mascots to boost your consumption. Satire? Simulation? Or simply addictive fun in the face of our modern worship of consumer culture?

89.title: Road Roller Da! ∞ ORAORA INFINITY
89.description:
Defend with Your Fist: Jotaro vs DIO in a Roadroller Showdown!
Inspired by the iconic anime moment, this defense-style mini-game pits you as Jotaro, fending off Dio’s endless barrage of falling road rollers. Punch fast, survive long, and rack up your score as the chaos intensifies. Simple to play, hard to master—pure ORA ORA fury.

90.title: MemeDam Website
90.description: Founded in 2025, MemeDam is a community platform focused on meme culture. It operates in a decentralized manner, allowing users to interact and rank memes by popularity. Our mission is to gather meme enthusiasts and 'weirdos' to build a meme utopia for sharing eccentric content. Track the latest trends, upload your favorite dark humor memes, and join the 'Hell Train' with fellow creators.

91.title: AniDaze Website
91.description: AniDaze is an anime broadcast schedule tracker. It provides detailed schedules for current seasonal anime and long-running series. Supports iCal calendar file download for direct import into your calendar, so you can stay updated on the latest anime.

92.title: Three.js 3D Interactive LOGO
92.description:
A Three.js project that combines design thinking with code implementation.

Using traditional three-point lighting with a dynamic particle field to create a tech-forward 3D interactive experience. Hovering over the model triggers accelerated rotation and glitch art effects; the light source follows the cursor for dynamic shadows.

This started as a job interview assignment but I couldn't stop working on it XD
Special attention was paid to animation fluidity and visual details—exponential easing for smoother motion transitions and performance optimizations for stable runs across devices.

**Tech:** Three.js, WebGL, Shader, Post-processing
**Dev time:** 1 week
